scope: Ordinary autonomous NPC work is suspended in the declared fixture. A real resident rest lease is accepted immediately after the craft checkpoint, while its response is held. Native reward double-click while the last real greenhouse Sokoban checkpoint response is held. The same accepted response is released after the click; no second click is sent afterward. Claims require exactly one protected receipt and one actual crafted compost bag. Closing a queued claim instead must cancel it without consuming inputs or granting a product. Fixture grants only recipe raw inputs, seeds, building 14 and funds; no finished product or game outcome is injected. Native input follows the generated legal solution. Models are disabled. This check does not cover full crop growth, zero-start journeys, human acceptance or physical Mac devices.
